pastDeadline.title: A cloud desktop outlived its deadline
pastDeadline.body: Desktop {subject} ({config}) still exists {minutes} min after its hard deadline and may still be billed. The Host keeps trying to delete it; check its state in settings.

cleanupStalled.title: Cloud desktop cleanup is stuck
cleanupStalled.body: Deleting desktop {subject} ({config}) has not been confirmed for {minutes} min. It may still be billed until E2B confirms it is gone.

templateCleanupStalled.title: Cloud desktop template cleanup is stuck
templateCleanupStalled.body: Deleting template {subject} ({config}) has not been confirmed for {minutes} min. The Host keeps retrying.

configForm.confirmationHint: Saving confirms the account plan and the rate as of now. Each confirmation is valid for at most 30 days; after that, desktops cannot be created until you confirm again.
configForm.credentialHint: The key is stored only on this Host and is never shown again. Replacing a stored key keeps the old one until every desktop and template created with it is gone.
configForm.deleteDescription: The configuration and every stored key generation are removed. This is refused while it still owns a desktop or template.
configForm.egressOffOnly: Network off. Desktops cannot reach the internet; open-network and allowlist egress are not qualified yet.

fields.copyFrom: Copy the key of a code sandbox provider

configForm.limitsHint: At most {concurrent} desktops, {lifetime} s lifetime and {idle} s idle. A configuration can only lower these limits.
configForm.rotateDescription: New desktops use the new key at once. The current key is kept until every desktop and template created with it is gone, then deleted.
configForm.enablementHint: Each switch can turn on only while this configuration's qualification receipts are current. Changing the configuration or its template makes them stale.
configForm.agentControlDormant: Chat agents cannot reach managed desktops yet; this switch only records consent.

costs: Subscription, template setup, taxes and other provider charges are additional. This estimate is not a total invoice cap.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete desktop {id}?
deleteConfirm.description: The desktop and everything on it are destroyed. Billing stops once E2B confirms it is gone.

description: Temporary Linux desktops managed by the selected Host with your E2B account.
dormant: Workspace access, live preview, persistence and suspend/resume remain dormant. GUI control, agent control and acceptance turn on per configuration after it qualifies on this Host. Agents may suggest acceptance but cannot authorize billed creation.
empty: No E2B desktop configuration exists on this Host yet.

errors.adminRequired: Only an owner device of this Host can change desktop configuration or keys.
errors.configExists: A configuration with this ID already exists. Choose another ID or edit the existing one.
errors.configInUse: This configuration still owns a desktop or template. Delete those first.
errors.configInvalid: The Host rejected this configuration. Check the size and limits.
errors.configNotFound: This configuration no longer exists on the Host. Refresh the list.
errors.configRevisionConflict: Someone else changed this configuration. Refresh it and apply your change again.
errors.credentialRotateRequired: A key is already stored. Replace it instead, so desktops created with the old key can still be cleaned up.
errors.credentialSourceEmpty: That code sandbox provider has no stored key.
errors.credentialSourceNotFound: That E2B code sandbox provider no longer exists on this Host.
errors.credentialSourceUnavailable: The code sandbox settings on this Host could not be read.
errors.credentialSourceUnsupported: That provider reads its key from an environment variable or a file, which is not copied. Paste the key instead.
errors.egressSmokeUnsupported: Only network-off desktops can currently be qualified. Open-network and allowlist configurations remain dormant until their own egress smoke checks are implemented and pass.
errors.entitlementLimit: The requested lifetime exceeds this E2B account plan. Hobby permits at most 1 hour and Pro at most 24 hours; Phase 1 still permits at most 60 minutes. The request was refused without shortening it.
errors.entitlementUnknown: The account lifetime limit is unknown or stale. Update the dated account plan binding on the Host before creating a desktop.
errors.humanRequired: Approve the pending request on the owning Host, then retry this action. If the estimate expires, refresh it and request approval again.
errors.policyLimit: The requested limit exceeds Phase 1 policy: at most 60 minutes, 10 idle minutes and 2 concurrent desktops. The request was refused without shortening it.
errors.priceUnknown: The cost estimate is missing or stale. Update the selected specification price on the Host and request a fresh estimate.
errors.quoteExpired: The estimate or approval expired. Refresh the estimate and approve the action again.
errors.releaseUnavailable: This Host has no trusted desktop release, so configurations cannot be saved or used yet.
errors.secretInvalid: The key must be a single token without spaces.
errors.secretUnavailable: The Host's secret store is unavailable. Try again.
errors.templateInUse: A desktop created from this template still exists. Delete the desktop first.
errors.templateNotFound: This template no longer exists on the Host. Refresh the list.
errors.templateOutcomeUnknown: The template's registration outcome is still being reconciled. Try again shortly.
errors.unknown: The Host could not complete this request. Refresh the configuration and quote, then try again.
errors.unqualified: Real-provider smoke has not qualified this configuration. Desktop creation remains disabled.
errors.enablementUnqualified: This switch needs current qualification receipts for this configuration. Turn it off or qualify again.
errors.qualificationRunning: A qualification run is already in progress for this configuration.
errors.qualificationNotFound: This qualification run no longer exists on the Host.
errors.qualificationQuoteMismatch: The run is waiting on a different estimate. Review the current one.
errors.qualificationNotAwaiting: The run is not waiting for an approval.
errors.handoffDeliveryUnknown: The selected delivery no longer exists on this Host.
errors.handoffScriptInvalid: Use an npm script name: start with a letter, digit, : or _, then letters, digits, : _ . or -.

guiDormant: Desktop viewing and control stay off until manual GUI is turned on for this configuration.

handoff.argvHelp: Use [] to skip launch, or ["npm", "run", "test"] to run a named package script after dependency installation. The command runs at the repository root; this field is not shell text.
handoff.description: Choose a delivery owned by this account on the selected Host. Preparation only validates source metadata and estimates cost; it does not create a desktop or run commands.
handoff.dormant: Acceptance execution is dormant until linked evidence and deletion are complete and authorized real-provider smoke passes. Agent suggestions cannot authorize spending.
handoff.empty: No eligible deliveries with trusted source provenance are available to this account on this Host.
handoff.files: Selected acceptance files (one repository-relative path per line)
handoff.filesHelp: Optional: at most 100 files, 32 MiB total and 8 MiB per file. The Host checks paths and content. Secrets, environment files and browser profiles are not copied automatically.
handoff.identityChanged: The account changed or was locked. Unlock the account and refresh the eligible deliveries.
handoff.prepare: Validate source and estimate acceptance cost
handoff.prepareFailed: The Host could not prepare this proposal. Check the source, selected files, launch arguments and provider configuration, then refresh and try again.
handoff.prepared: Prepared exact commit {commit} from delivery revision {revision}. No desktop has been created.
handoff.sourceScope: Commit and bundle reconstruction transfers repository history. Selected acceptance files are additional copies; selecting them does not filter or sanitize source history.
handoff.sourceUnavailable: This delivery is missing trusted provenance, changed or is no longer available. Refresh the eligible deliveries.
handoff.title: Prepare GUI acceptance
handoff.unsupported: Live preview, transfer between Hosts and automatic project acceptance remain unavailable.

hostConfig: Configure E2B desktops on this Host below. The API key is stored on the Host and never shown again.
invalidLifetime: Lifetime must be between 1 and 60 minutes and within the Host limit; it is never shortened automatically.
limits: At most {count} desktops per owner/provider on this Host; {minutes} minute hard deadline and {idle} minute idle cleanup. Other Hosts do not share this quota.
manual: Each billed action requires your explicit approval on the owning Host. Nothing is provisioned by opening this panel.
maximum: Maximum desktop compute within this deadline: {cost}

monitor.title: Billing and cleanup
monitor.billed: {count, plural, =0 {No desktop is billed right now.} one {# desktop may still be billed.} other {# desktops may still be billed.}}

alert.pastDeadline: Desktop {subject} is past its hard deadline.
alert.cleanupStalled: Cleanup of desktop {subject} is not confirmed.
alert.templateCleanupStalled: Cleanup of template {subject} is not confirmed.

prepared: Pinned template prepared. Real-provider smoke authorization and qualification are still required before creation.
quoteNeeded: Refresh the estimate before preparing a template or creating a desktop. An expired estimate must be confirmed again.

release.absent: No trusted desktop release is installed on this Host, so new desktops cannot be provisioned. Status, deletion and cleanup still work.
release.invalid: The Host's desktop release manifest is invalid. New desktops are refused until it is replaced; status, deletion and cleanup still work.

cleanup.description: Evidence deletion is not yet physically confirmed. Select the original Host before retrying; offline cleanup stays queued.
cleanup.failed: Cleanup could not finish. The receipt remains queued.
cleanup.title: Pending acceptance cleanup

results.cleanupPending: Desktop or evidence cleanup is pending.
results.deleteDescription: This removes the acceptance history and private screenshots through the owning Host. The source task remains. An offline Host keeps a pending cleanup receipt until physical cleanup is confirmed.
results.deleteTitle: Delete this acceptance and its evidence?
results.dormant: New acceptance execution remains unavailable until provider qualification is complete.
results.empty: No desktop acceptance is linked to this task or run.
results.independent: Your decision is recorded separately from the agent verdict. It does not merge code or complete the original task.
results.limitReached: Evidence limit reached. Missing required screenshots cannot produce a passing result.
results.noAgentVerdict: No agent verdict has been recorded.
results.notReviewed: No human decision has been recorded.
results.private: Checkpoint and failure screenshots are private to this account. No sharing link is generated.
results.title: Desktop acceptance results
results.unavailable: Acceptance history or evidence is unavailable. Check the owning Host and account, or wait for deletion to finish.

smokeResource: Qualification smoke resource — not approved for production use

templates.title: Templates
templates.empty: No template has been prepared on this Host.
templates.deleteDescription: The template and all of its builds are removed from your E2B account. Preparing it again later is billed again.
templates.inUse: {count, plural, one {Used by # desktop} other {Used by # desktops}}

title: Managed cloud desktops

qualification.title: Qualification
qualification.description: Runs the native checks on this Host with temporary desktops. Every billed step waits for your approval; cancelling destroys what the run created.
qualification.noDeliveries: No delivery on this Host can be handed off.
qualification.scriptHelp: Runs as npm run followed by this name, at the repository root.
qualification.scriptInvalid: Use an npm script name: start with a letter, digit, : or _, then letters, digits, : _ . or -.
qualification.templateBuildCharges: Template preparation may also incur provider build charges that this estimate does not include.
qualification.cancelDescription: The Host stops the run and destroys every desktop it created. Receipts already recorded stay.
qualification.empty: No qualification run on this Host yet.
